description: Canonical candidate catalog, sourced from docs/COMPONENT_CATALOG_V1.md. Implementation status is explicit and is not an accessibility certification.

statuses.specified: Behavior and anatomy defined in the written specification, but no reviewed v1 implementation.
statuses.experimental: At least one reference web implementation or treatment exists; APIs and accessibility are not stable.
statuses.stable: Audited, versioned and supported implementation; none have reached this stage.

components.name: Button
components.anatomy: label, optional leading/trailing glyph, spinner; primary, secondary, outline, quiet, danger; S/M/L
components.behavior: Enter/Space; submit/reset types explicit; busy state does not change width; icon never sole confirmation

components.name: Icon button
components.anatomy: hit zone 44; icon 20/24; quiet, filled, tonal, danger
components.behavior: programmatic name mandatory; toggle variant exposes pressed state; tooltip not substitute for name

components.name: Split button
components.behavior: separate focus stops; ArrowDown opens menu; default action predictable

components.name: Floating action
components.anatomy: single elevated short action, optional label
components.behavior: one dominant FAB per task context; never obscure content or mobile nav

components.name: Segmented control
components.behavior: one persistent selected item; use radio group when genuinely exclusive and form-like; arrow key behavior per chosen widget pattern

components.name: Action menu
components.behavior: opens on Enter/Space; Up/Down/Home/End, Escape closes, focus returns; destructive actions separated

components.name: Overflow menu
components.behavior: never hide the only way to accomplish primary task in overflow

components.name: Toolbar
components.anatomy: grouped commands, optional search and title
components.behavior: roving focus only where ARIA pattern applies; adaptive overflow must preserve command names

components.name: Text field
components.anatomy: persistent label, input, helper/error, optional prefix/suffix, clear
components.behavior: label never replaced by placeholder; text selection works; error ID via aria-describedby

components.name: Text area
components.anatomy: label, expanding editor, count and help
components.behavior: resizable unless product-specific editor; no unexpected autocorrect of data

components.name: Search field
components.behavior: keyboard suggestion list pattern; Escape clears popup first; announce results count

components.name: Password
components.anatomy: field plus reveal button, strength guidance
components.behavior: reveal state named; caps lock notice optional; no forced clipboard prevention

components.name: Checkbox
components.behavior: Space toggles; grouped fieldset/legend; mixed is programmatic

components.name: Radio group
components.anatomy: circle, label, helper; one checked per group
components.behavior: arrow keys navigate/select in standard grouped radio pattern

components.name: Switch
components.behavior: on/off programmatic state; Space toggles; never for deferred submit form choice

components.name: Slider
components.behavior: arrow/Home/End/Page keys; numerical accessible min/max/now, discrete step announcement

components.name: Select
components.behavior: use native select preferentially on mobile; typeahead, Escape, restored focus

components.name: Combobox
components.behavior: implement recognized ARIA combobox keyboard model; async results cancel stale requests

components.name: Date/time picker
components.anatomy: editable display and calendar/grid or native system picker
components.behavior: locale format, timezone and DST explicit; no color-only date availability

components.name: File picker
components.behavior: keyboard activation plus browse alternative to drag/drop; show max size/type

components.name: Stepper/number
components.behavior: bounds announced; manual entry supported; avoid repeated accidental increments

components.name: Form validation summary
components.behavior: submit focuses summary when blocking, field IDs linked; preserve entered data

components.name: Surface / Card
components.anatomy: header, body, action footer; flat, tonal, outlined, clickable
components.behavior: only whole-card click when truly one destination; no nested actionable elements in button

components.name: Lens panel
components.behavior: floating navigation/temporary control only; solid fallback; no Lens-in-Lens

components.name: List
components.anatomy: optional grouped headings, row, metadata, actions
components.behavior: row content supports 2 lines normally; actionable rows have clear destination

components.name: List row
components.anatomy: leading glyph/media, title, subtitle, trailing affordance
components.behavior: touch zone 44–48; selection indicator independent of hover

components.name: Data table
components.anatomy: column headers, sorting, selection, bulk actions
components.behavior: native table semantics; headers mapped to cells; sort state announced

components.name: Grid
components.behavior: DOM reading order must match visual order; avoid masonry trapping keyboard

components.name: Tree view
components.behavior: Left/Right expand/collapse in LTR; home/end; typeahead; selected vs focused distinct

components.name: Accordion
components.behavior: Enter/Space toggles; aria-expanded; region labels; multiple/single policy stated

components.name: Tabs
components.behavior: keyboard Arrow/Home/End, tab to active panel; automatic activation only when latency negligible

components.name: Badge/Chip
components.behavior: status is noninteractive badge; removable chip has independently named remove button

components.name: Avatar
components.behavior: image has useful alt if identifying; status never solely colored dot

components.name: Tooltip
components.behavior: appears on hover and keyboard focus, Escape dismisses; not essential instructions

components.name: Popover
components.anatomy: nonmodal interactive overlay anchored to trigger
components.behavior: focus stays sensible; Escape and outside click policy; scroll boundary tracking

components.name: Skeleton
components.behavior: hide decorative skeletons from screen reader; loading status announced once

components.name: Charts
components.behavior: series distinguished by shape/labels, tabular equivalent, keyboard data exploration

components.name: App bar
components.behavior: at most two high-priority actions exposed on compact widths

components.name: Bottom navigation
components.behavior: never scrollable by default; safe-area inset; selection visible without color

components.name: Navigation rail
components.behavior: for medium widths; labels available on focus/selection or always when space allows

components.name: Navigation sidebar
components.behavior: desktop persistent when room; collapse preserves context and scroll position

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.behavior: only for hierarchical spaces; use nav landmark; don't duplicate a back control needlessly

components.name: Pagination
components.behavior: reachable keyboard buttons, current page announced; don't trap focus on page rerender

components.name: Command palette
components.behavior: invoked by discoverable command; Escape returns focus; no hidden essential functionality

components.name: Stepper/wizard
components.behavior: current step announced; users can review; do not lose entered data

components.name: Toast/snackbar
components.behavior: polite announcement, does not steal focus; time limit extends/pauses where necessary

components.name: Inline banner
components.anatomy: icon, severity, title, description, optional action
components.behavior: semantic intent with text; do not overuse warning color

components.name: Alert dialog
components.behavior: modal focus containment; Escape handling; safe focus initial for irreversible action

components.name: Dialog
components.behavior: max width 560, scroll content not whole viewport; close restores invoking focus

components.name: Bottom sheet
components.behavior: gesture and keyboard equivalent; safe-area inset; predictable dismissal

components.name: Side sheet
components.behavior: preferred for tablet/desktop detail; focus order preserves app context

components.name: Progress
components.behavior: role, label and numerical value when known; reduced motion fallback

components.name: Empty state
components.behavior: informative, not celebratory when blocked; one relevant action

components.name: Error/retry state
components.behavior: distinguish offline, permission, validation, server and destructive failure

components.name: Media player chrome
components.behavior: labeled controls; keyboard/media-key support; Lens over imagery with robust scrim

components.name: Image viewer
components.behavior: pointer/touch and keyboard equivalents; alt text; avoid scroll-jank

components.name: Drag-and-drop item
components.behavior: reorder actions and keyboard alternative, announcement on relocation

components.name: Calendar
components.behavior: accessible events list alternative; timezone and first weekday localized

components.name: Timeline
components.behavior: list semantics; color+shape status; time format locale aware

components.name: Notification center
components.behavior: clear affordance for read/unread; no focus theft on arrival

components.name: Context menu
components.behavior: keyboard Shift+F10/context-menu key; touch long-press is optional shortcut

components.name: Split view
components.anatomy: primary and detail panes, resize handle
components.behavior: draggable and keyboard resize, minimum widths and collapse

components.name: Onboarding tour
components.behavior: never block core tasks after first use; no forced motion; progress and dismiss
